description: This file defines the KendraRankingClient class, a client for interacting with the Amazon Kendra Intelligent Ranking service via AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations like creating, deleting, describing, listing, rescoring, tagging, untagging, and updating rescore execution plans.

classes.name: KendraRankingClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Kendra Intelligent Ranking service, extending the AwsClient base class.
